visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A calico cat with white, orange, and black patches stands on a light-colored carpet in an indoor setting with a black cabinet in the background. A human hand extends a single finger toward the cat's face. The cat leans in to sniff the finger cautiously. Large black and white text with a slight shadow appears at the bottom of the frame. (2) The scene cuts to a white and orange cat sitting on a light floor near a black office chair. A hand reaches out and rubs the cat's jaw and chin area. The cat closes its eyes slightly and leans its face into the hand, showing a positive reaction. A yellow star icon and black text appear on screen. (3) A different white and orange cat is shown sitting on a grey padded chair indoors. A finger gently touches the tip of its nose and then its forehead. The cat remains still, closing its eyes in a relaxed manner. A series of three yellow stars and favorability text are overlaid on the cat's chest area. (4) The same white and orange cat is pet under the chin vigorously with two fingers. The cat tilts its head back, exposing its neck, and appears to enjoy the interaction. Five yellow stars and variety-style text appear. (5) A brown tabby cat stands on a yellow surface near a computer monitor. A hand rubs its cheek, and the cat nuzzles against the finger, occasionally opening its mouth slightly. Two yellow stars appear. (6) A black cat is nestled in a green and brown pet bed inside a cardboard box. A hand touches its nose and then scratches its cheek. The cat rubs its head against the hand enthusiastically. Three yellow stars appear.

It uses a consistent interaction (finger to nose/chin) to elicit diverse feline reactions, which are then humorously graded using star ratings and variety-show style text overlays. The goal is to highlight the different personalities of the cats in a cute and lighthearted manner.
